[Miraculous Medic](/Feats.aspx?ID=5339) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>

Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death. Once per day, you can cast [_breath of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1456) as an innate primal spell.
